pages.text: $(thing)Easy Farms$() adds four machines that farm almost everything in Minecraft: a $(item)Resource Farm$(), a $(item)Plant Farm$(), a $(item)Mob Farm$() and a $(item)Liquid Farm$() that makes water and lava.$(br2)What a farm makes is not built into the block. You put items into it and it matches them against $(thing)recipes$(). Swap the items, get a different result.

Each farm is a glass case that shows what it is doing: a block being mined by a swinging tool, a plant growing, or a mob standing inside.$(br2)This book explains the farms, the upgrade cards, and lists every recipe the farms know.
